paragraphs.label: Source
paragraphs.text: Recorded visit, patient consent on file.

paragraphs.label: Opening narrative
paragraphs.text: Patient was admitted for a major depressive episode with anxiety and was started on escitalopram 10 milligrams daily.

paragraphs.label: Psychiatric history
paragraphs.text: Patient reports improved mood but persistent evening anxiety. Patient denies suicidal thoughts.

paragraphs.label: Substance use history
paragraphs.text: Patient reports alcohol use of two glasses of wine weekly.

paragraphs.label: Program course by problem
paragraphs.text: Patient was educated on the risks of stopping escitalopram but declined to continue the medication.

paragraphs.label: Response to interventions
paragraphs.text: Patient prefers to pursue therapy only and will be referred to a therapist, Ms. Brooks.

paragraphs.label: Condition at discharge
paragraphs.text: Patient is stable for discharge with moderate risk due to ongoing anxiety and decision to stop medication.

paragraphs.label: Discharge medications / follow-up / disposition
paragraphs.text: Patient declined escitalopram and will be referred to a therapist. Patient is advised to call primary care doctor within one week.

paragraphs.label: Risks / benefits / alternatives discussed
paragraphs.text: The risks of stopping medication, including that symptoms may return

paragraphs.label: Follow-up / referrals
paragraphs.text: The patient will be referred to a therapist, Ms. Brooks, and should call her primary care doctor within one week.
